name: sample-node-app
description: Minimal Node.js app to validate an end-to-end DevSecOps pipeline (Gitleaks, Semgrep, Dependency-Check, SonarQube, Trivy, ZAP).

scripts.test: node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', r => { if (r.statusCode !== 200) process.exit(1); let d=''; r.on('data', c => d+=c); r.on('end', ()=>{ try { const j=JSON.parse(d); if(j.status!=='OK') process.exit(1); } catch(e){ process.exit(1); } }); }).on('error', ()=>process.exit(1));"
